about: Evaluation answer key for 20 fictional Common Application JSON profiles (app-1.json through app-20.json) testing cross-section consistency (timeline, hours/timing, counts) and real-world factual accuracy.

places.quote: When I founded the Silicon Valley Student Robotics Collective with two classmates

mistakes.explanation: Activity 1 lists participation only in grades 11 and 12, contradicting the personal essay where the applicant describes founding the robotics collective during sophomore year (grade 10).

places.quote: 11, 12 (Break)
During the summer before twelfth grade, while testing soil-moisture sensors in a Morgan Hill apricot orchard

trickyConsistent.explanation: Summer before 12th grade is logged under grade 11/12 Break, which is consistent with Common App summer reporting conventions.

mistakes.explanation: Honor 1 (Georgia Scholastic Press Association Best News Feature) is listed in grade 9, before the applicant joined The Peachtree Chronicle in grade 10.

places.quote: Every Saturday morning since eleventh grade, I have sat at that machine wearing white cotton gloves

trickyConsistent.explanation: Year-round Saturday shifts starting in 11th grade accurately match grades 11, 12 (Year).

places.quote: Installed 8 low-cost PM2.5 air sensors near highway crossings in El Paso; analyzed dust-storm particulate spikes with UTEP mentors.
Over six months, we mounted fifteen solar-powered particulate sensors on neighborhood porches, community centers, and our bakery's own awning.
When I helped deploy fifteen low-cost PM2.5 air sensors across border neighborhoods with the Borderlands Environmental Youth Coalition

mistakes.explanation: Activity 3 states 8 air sensors were installed, whereas both the personal essay and UT Austin supplement state 15 sensors were deployed.

places.quote: 12 hr/wk, 48 wk/yr
At 5:15 a.m. on Saturdays, the ovens at Panadería La Estrella smell of toasted anise, cinnamon, and warm yeast

trickyConsistent.explanation: Weekend bakery shifts starting at 5:15 a.m. across Saturday and Sunday total 12 hours per week consistently.

places.quote: 25 hr/wk, 48 wk/yr

mistakes.explanation: Activity 1 claims 48 weeks per year strictly during 'School' timing, which exceeds the ~36-week academic school year.

places.quote: 28 hr/wk, 12 wk/yr
Working summers as a mechanic at Lincoln Square Cyclery in Chicago

trickyConsistent.explanation: 28 hours/week for 12 weeks during Break matches a full-time summer bike mechanic job.

places.quote: USACO Diamond Division Competitor

mistakes.explanation: The USA Computing Olympiad (USACO) consists of Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum divisions; there is no Diamond division.

places.quote: Three weeks before my Bharatanatyam Arangetram—the two-hour solo debut that marks nine years of classical Indian dance training

trickyConsistent.explanation: Year-round practice throughout grades 9–12 aligns with preparing for a traditional Bharatanatyam Arangetram solo debut.

places.quote: 11, 12 (School)

mistakes.explanation: Honor 2 lists qualifying for NCHSAA 3A West Regional Wrestling in grades 10 and 11, but Activity 3 lists high school wrestling participation only in grades 11 and 12.

places.quote: When Hurricane Helene swept through western North Carolina in the fall of my sophomore year

trickyConsistent.explanation: For a Class of 2027 senior, sophomore fall was Fall 2024, when Hurricane Helene devastated western North Carolina (September 2024).

places.quote: 7 hr/wk, 44 wk/yr

mistakes.explanation: Activity 3 lists 44 weeks per year while marked as 'Break' only, which is impossible since school breaks do not span 44 weeks of the year.

places.quote: Concours Général de Philosophie Regional Finalist

trickyConsistent.explanation: In the French lycée system, students sit for the Concours Général in Première (grade 11) and Terminale (grade 12).

places.quote: AP Physics C: Mechanics & Calculus BC National AP Scholar

mistakes.explanation: The College Board discontinued the National AP Scholar award in 2021, so a Class of 2027 student could not have earned it in grade 11.

places.quote: every Yamanote Line platform plays a distinct seven-second departure melody composed specifically to calm commuters while nudging them aboard.

trickyConsistent.explanation: JR East stations on Tokyo's Yamanote Line genuinely use distinct ~7-second platform departure melodies (hassha melody).

places.quote: 12 (Break)
That changed during tenth grade when a tropical storm flooded my grandmother's ground-floor apartment in Little Havana
That question led me to the Miami Urban Resilience Design Studio the following summer, where I spent eight weeks studying vernacular Caribbean stilt houses

mistakes.explanation: The summer following 10th grade corresponds to grade 11 (rising junior), contradicting Activity 2 listing participation only in grade 12.

places.quote: Every October during king tide in Miami, saltwater bubbles up through storm drains along Calle Ocho

trickyConsistent.explanation: South Florida king tides peak in October and frequently back up through storm drains in low-lying neighborhoods like Little Havana.

places.quote: 11, 12 (Break)
Volunteering as an IRS VITA tax preparer each spring grounded those numbers in human reality

mistakes.explanation: Activity 4 lists 'Break' timing, contradicting spring IRS VITA tax-season volunteering (January–April) during the school year.

places.quote: We scraped 150 years of Minnesota Department of Natural Resources lake ice-out dates

trickyConsistent.explanation: The Minnesota DNR actually maintains historical lake ice-out datasets extending back to the mid-1800s.

places.quote: Built 15 portable solar-battery study lamps and rooftop microgrid monitors for students in Makoko and Lekki communities.
Our first batch of twenty lamps was an engineering humiliation.
When we delivered forty redesigned lamps the following term, thirty-nine were still running smoothly eight months later

mistakes.explanation: Activity 1 states 15 lamps were built, contradicting the personal essay which describes delivering 20 initial lamps followed by 40 redesigned lamps (60 total).

places.quote: Yale Young African Scholars Alumni Award

trickyConsistent.explanation: Yale Young African Scholars (YYAS) is a real selective summer program for African secondary school students typically completed after 10th or 11th grade.

places.quote: 11, 12 (Break)
Working early morning shifts at Cedar Mill Coffee Roasters before school reinforced that same patience

mistakes.explanation: Activity 3 is marked as 'Break' only (46 weeks/year), contradicting the essay's statement that the applicant worked early shifts before school.

places.quote: OSAA 6A Metro League All-Academic Soccer Team

trickyConsistent.explanation: OSAA 6A Metro League is the real athletic conference for large suburban high schools in Washington County, Oregon.

places.quote: With two classmates, I founded Guanabara Bay Youth Ocean Watch to shift from reactive trash pickup to spatial diagnostics.

mistakes.explanation: The personal essay places the founding of Guanabara Bay Youth Ocean Watch in 10th grade, contradicting Activity 1 which lists only grades 11 and 12.

places.quote: Swimming five kilometers in open Atlantic swells teaches you to read currents by subtle shifts in water temperature and foam lines.

trickyConsistent.explanation: Copacabana faces the open Atlantic Ocean just outside the mouth of Guanabara Bay, where coastal currents exchange debris.

places.quote: 10 (School)
That curiosity led me to spend the summer before twelfth grade in a polymer research cohort in Cleveland

mistakes.explanation: Activity 1 lists grade 10 (School), contradicting the essay which specifies the summer before 12th grade (grade 11/12 Break).

places.quote: At Case Western Reserve University, I want to major in Macromolecular Science and Engineering—one of the few dedicated polymer programs in the country

trickyConsistent.explanation: CWRU genuinely houses one of the nation's premier dedicated Macromolecular Science and Engineering departments alongside Sears think[box].

places.quote: 12 (School)
That changed when two classmates and I decided to start South Side Preparatory Academy's first mock trial team.

mistakes.explanation: Activity 1 lists participation only in grade 12, contradicting the essay's account of founding the team in 10th grade and reaching state quarterfinals in 11th grade.

places.quote: QuestBridge College Prep Scholar

trickyConsistent.explanation: QuestBridge College Prep Scholars are selected during junior year (grade 11).

places.quote: Intel Science Talent Search Semifinalist

mistakes.explanation: Intel ended its sponsorship of the Science Talent Search in 2016; since 2017 it has been the Regeneron Science Talent Search.

places.quote: Captured exoplanet transit light curves using school's 11-inch Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope; submitted data to AAVSO.

trickyConsistent.explanation: An 11-inch Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope with a cooled CMOS camera can detect ~1% hot-Jupiter transit dips and submit photometry to the AAVSO Exoplanet Database.

places.quote: During the Quebec provincial 1500-meter semifinals in tenth grade, I entered the final lap in second place
Two summers later, that exact lesson surfaced in a completely different lab. While interning with a computational neuroimaging group in Montreal

mistakes.explanation: Two summers after 10th grade would be the summer after 12th grade (post-graduation), which has not occurred yet for a 12th-grade applicant.

places.quote: Canadian Open Mathematics Challenge (COMC) Quebec Honor Roll

trickyConsistent.explanation: The Canadian Open Mathematics Challenge (COMC) is administered nationally by the Canadian Mathematical Society with provincial honor rolls.

places.quote: 12 (Year)
When I joined the Phoenix High School Solar Vehicle Team in tenth grade, I was fascinated by aerodynamic carbon-fiber shells

mistakes.explanation: Activity 1 lists participation only in grade 12, contradicting the essay's statement that the student joined the solar vehicle team in 10th grade.

places.quote: Purdue's School of Mechanical Engineering—and specifically the Ray W. Herrick Laboratories, where researchers tackle high-efficiency HVAC, thermal systems, and acoustics

trickyConsistent.explanation: Purdue's Ray W. Herrick Laboratories is a real research facility renowned for HVAC, thermal systems, and acoustics.

places.quote: 12 (School)
On a snowy Sunday afternoon in tenth grade, I carried my violin into a quiet rehabilitation ward in Boston
First, I founded Notes for Healing Boston, recruiting twenty-two student musicians to play weekly acoustic sessions in hospital wards

mistakes.explanation: Activity 3 lists participation only in grade 12, contradicting the essay which states Notes for Healing Boston was founded in 10th grade.

places.quote: Led first violins in Jordan Hall performances

trickyConsistent.explanation: Jordan Hall is the historic primary concert venue of the New England Conservatory in Boston.

places.quote: During my sophomore track season in Houston, I spent three straight weeks fouling four out of every five throws

mistakes.explanation: Honor 1 lists an iGEM High School medal in grade 9, before the applicant joined the synthetic biology club in grade 10.

places.quote: Steps from the Texas Medical Center and Rice's Oshman Engineering Design Kitchen

trickyConsistent.explanation: Rice University is located directly across from the Texas Medical Center and houses the Oshman Engineering Design Kitchen (OEDK).
